name: Melissa
source:
Specialty: Brewing black tea
Hobby: None in particular
Likes: Toys
Dislikes: Ghost

A maid employed in Tooko's mansion. She claims to be an orthodox Victorian maid and is a top-notch house keeper. Above all, her brewed black tea is a perfection that even Chief is made growl by it, but the only dish she can cook is Fish and Chips.

"Today's lunch is Herbal Tea and Fish and Chips. Please be glad to take a partake."

[spoiler]Her full name is actually Kayano Melissa (茅野メリッサ)[/spoiler]
